description: User raised allowing Web to build LiveView structs directly while keeping the substrate target-independent. Current path is component.render -> Renderer.walk_child copies vnode tree and resolves child fibers/events -> Web.to_rendered traverses it again. Profile mount allocations and time before redesign. Prototype an optional render-target callback inherited by child RenderContexts that builds output during reconciliation; preserve the default vnode path for other targets. Separate removal of the walked copy from compiling templates directly to target output. Preserve event registration order and capture, slots/defaults, scalar/charlist/safe escaping, static/dynamic fingerprints, keyed children, hook lifecycles and nested component renders. Verify incremental client HTML and live event dispatch; benchmark matched actual Web paths at 10/100/1000 rows with identical harness/runtime before choosing whether to land the change. Do not remove the portable IR solely on timing from one run.
title: Evaluate direct render targets without a walked vnode intermediate
